description: This Python source file defines an adapter class for integrating Anthropic's language models with the Pipecat framework. It handles conversion of message formats, manages context-specific parameters, sanitizes messages for logging, and transforms function schemas into Anthropic-compatible definitions.

classes.name: AnthropicLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for converting Pipecat's standard message schemas and context into Anthropic-compatible formats, managing prompt caching markers, and transforming function schemas.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: Dataclass used internally to store messages and system message during format conversion from universal context.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns 'anthropic' as the identifier used in LLMSpecificMessage instances for Anthropic.

methods.name: AnthropicLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params( self, context: LLMContext, enable_prompt_caching: bool )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the invocation parameters for Anthropic's LLM API based on the provided context.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Sanitizes and prepares messages from the context for safe logging, removing sensitive or large data like images or signatures.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal context messages into Anthropic-specific message format, handling system messages, message roles, and content merging.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts an individual universal context message into Anthropic format, handling specific types like 'thought' messages.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_anthropic_specific_message(self, message: LLMSpecificMessage)
methods.description: Handles conversion of LLMSpecificMessage objects, particularly 'thought' messages, into Anthropic message format.

methods.name: MessageParam _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Converts general universal messages to Anthropic format, managing tool calls, image handling, and content normalization.

methods.name: List[MessageParam] _with_cache_control_markers(self, messages: List[MessageParam])
methods.description: Adds cache control markers to messages to assist prompt caching and retrieval in Anthropic.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_anthropic_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Converts a FunctionSchema object into the dictionary format required by Anthropic's API.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Transforms a ToolsSchema into a list of function definitions formatted for Anthropic's API.
